assets.promptExact:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: identity BASE sprite for an animated fireplace fire in DEAD SECTOR, a retro horror FPS. Input image 1 is the user's CONCEPT reference: take the FIRE inside the ornate hearth as the specific visual target, especially its tall jagged asymmetrical tongues and intensely yellow lower body. Do not redraw any architecture or objects. Image 2 is the ACTUAL GAME soot-dark brick texture, reference only for visible blocky painted pixel clusters and subdued warm surroundings.
Generate ONE frontal orthographic FIRE FLAME MASS ONLY on genuine transparent alpha. Broad low hot root, lively tall narrow flame tips, a dense pale warm golden-yellow core rising from the lower middle, amber streaks, vermilion-orange outer tongues fading to deep red tips. Match a natural vigorous wood fire from the concept, with irregular torn triangular tongues and split tips. Highest narrow tongue a little right of center, two secondary tall peaks, short side flickers, uneven gaps. Tiny detached orange embers above are allowed only within the same controlled silhouette bounds. Less than 6 detached sparks. It is NOT a bonfire cone, NOT five identical smooth S-shaped curls, NOT a vector flame icon.
Composition / animation invariants: square canvas, left and right margins at least 9%, root extends horizontally from x14% to x86%, brightest solid bottom edge planted at y89% (the root ANCHOR), absolutely nothing below y90%; tallest tips around y9%, side tongues around y35-55%. Flame body should occupy most of the height above the root. Flat front view with no camera tilt, identity base before making 8 frames. Keep flame root and total scale fixed for later animation. NO logs, coals, floor line, grille, stone, room, border, labels, text, smoke, checkerboard paint, or opaque dark background. Existing 3D logs and coals are already present in the game.
Art: crisp jagged stepped pixel shapes with larger readable color clusters, late 1990s / early 2000s painted game VFX, 8-12 warm color families, warm ivory-yellow highlights #ffe4a0 but no pure white. No rounded cartoon, no glossy 3D, no blurry photograph, no broad airbrushed glow haze beyond alpha. Keep luminosity inside the silhouette; a thin translucent amber edge is fine. Requested1024x1024 RGBA transparent. Should still read as vigorous detailed fire when reduced to128x128.

assets.promptExact:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE game texture atlas of three rigid carved fireplace details for DEAD SECTOR, a retro horror FPS in a Victorian mansion. Reference image 1 is COMPOSITION / carved fireplace motif only (lion masks, acanthus scrolls, small antique mantel clock). References 2 and 3 are the ACTUAL GAME stone and soot-dark brick for coarse pixel art style and subdued material colors, not shapes to copy.
Output a square 1024 x 1024 genuinely transparent PNG, three completely separate elements with exact cell allocation and generous transparent margin. TOP HALF cell x0..1023 y0..511: one wide horizontal shallow STONE relief, a central small pointed heraldic shield with symmetrical curling acanthus leaves, 2:1 overall motif, isolated and front orthographic. The relief is dark warm limestone #71685b with muted lighter #9d917c facets, charcoal crevices, restrained chips, broad readable ornamental forms. NO architectural frame behind it. BOTTOM LEFT cell x0..511 y512..1023: one carved STONE LION HEAD mask, majestic worn expression, mane flowing down, small ring held in mouth, straight-on symmetrical view, matching EXACTLY the dark warm stone of top relief. BOTTOM RIGHT cell x512..1023 y512..1023: one small ornate Victorian brass mantel CLOCK, domed pediment, aged ivory dial with twelve short tick marks and two black hands, dark brass casing, broad plinth; front orthographic, no legible letters or numerals necessary.
All 3 independent objects centered within their assigned cell, fully contained with at least 8% transparent margin on all sides. NO overlaps between cells, no grid, no labels, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow outside silhouettes, no fire, no candles, no room, no portrait. NO repeating whole fireplace. Each is a shallow front-facing bas-relief sprite to put over 3D stone or on top of a mantel. Keep crisp stepped pixel clusters and large shapes that read when the entire atlas is downsampled to 512x512. Matte late-1990s game texture / painted pixel art, NOT photographic, NOT polished metal, no smooth vector edges, no glossy 3D render. Diffuse neutral ambient shading ONLY within carving crevices, no orange firelight painted in, no directional room lighting, no glow. True alpha transparency outside the three elements including gaps, no checkerboard paint.
